description: Dewan Farooque Spinning Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 22 December 2003, and its principal activity is the manufacture and sale of fine quality yarn, including yarn produced on contract for other customers. Its mill is at 54 Km on Multan Road, Phool Nagar Bypass, District Kasur, and its stated mission is to be recognised as a premium quality yarn manufacturing unit producing fine count compact yarn. Its registered office is at Dewan Centre in Karachi, and the company is listed among the companies of Yousuf Dewan Companies on the group's website.
